instruction: Single Room IFC Shell This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Use Bonsai's native IFC authoring workflow to create a metric IFC4 single-room BIM shell, then save the required output as result.ifc. 1. The output folder contains result.ifc at least 500 bytes. 2. Result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema. 3. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 1 IfcBuildingStorey, 1 IfcSpace, 4 IfcWall entities, 1 IfcSlab, 1 IfcDoor, 1 IfcWindow, 2 IfcOpeningElement entities, 2 IfcRelVoidsElement relationships, and 2 IfcRelFillsElement relationships. 4. The IFC model contains 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy, 0 IfcFurniture, 0 IfcRoof, 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, 0 IfcStair, and 0 IfcFlowTerminal entities. 5. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique. 6. The single IfcSpace is named exactly Room 101 after trimming leading and trailing whitespace. 7. The Room 101 IfcSpace geometry has world-coordinate plan spans of X = 5.20 m and Y = 4.40 m with tolerance +/-0.10 m. 8. Each IfcWall geometry has height 3.00 m with tolerance +/-0.10 m. 9. The Entry Door IfcDoor has OverallWidth 0.90 m with tolerance +/-0.05 m and fills exactly one IfcOpeningElement that voids the IfcWall named West Wall. 10. The North Window IfcWindow has OverallWidth 1.40 m with tolerance +/-0.05 m and fills exactly one different IfcOpeningElement that voids the IfcWall named North Wall. Any item not explicitly required may vary.
